# NLAlib: randomized numerical linear algebra in Lean 4

Lean v4.33.1; the exact Mathlib revision is pinned in lake-manifest.json.

## Imports and proof status

- `import NLAlib` is the scaffold-free default. AuditTrusted.lean checks every reachable library
  declaration, including definitions, instances and private helpers, for nonstandard axioms.
- `import NLAlib.Experimental` includes unfinished proofs and their dependants.
- import_surface.json lists default modules and excluded modules with their experimental roots.
  Topic aggregators import the whole topic and may include experimental work.
- declarations.json includes every public declaration in the complete development: name, kind,
  module, line, signature, doc, sorry, atlas tags and uses. `sorry: true` is transitive, including
  derived theorems whose own proof body contains no sorry.
- atlas.json catalogues research results, hypotheses, sources, formalizations and their status.
  `scaffold` includes results depending on unfinished proofs. Ordinary helpers need no atlas
  entry of their own; their status is still recorded in declarations.json.

## Finding and using a result

Search atlas.json for the mathematical statement, then declarations.json for its exact type.
Use the default import or a module listed in the default surface. Matrix APIs generally use
finite index types and RCLike scalars where appropriate. Named matrix norms distinguish spectral
and Frobenius structures; bridge lemmas connect them to Mathlib's scoped norms. The general
pseudoinverse is moorePenroseInverse; pinvL and pinvR are full-rank formula helpers.
Subspaces use columnSpace and rangeProjector. Principal-angle interfaces distinguish the
field-generic directedSubspaceGap from the real overlapTangentNorm and guarded tanThetaMax.

Random matrices are functions into Matrix. Gaussian matrix laws are
`gaussianMatrix m n : Measure (Matrix m n ℝ)` for finite row and column types; `HasLaw X ν μ`
carries a.e. measurability and the push-forward identity. Probability guarantees should be
applied as event probabilities or Bochner integrals under their specified laws. Finite sums and
recurrences serve as computational identities. A theorem for a supplied compression is not an
operation-count theorem for a named algorithm without a realization and size argument.

## Contributing

Read CONTRIBUTING.md and the authoritative docs/STANDARDS.md. First settle the mathematical
statement and its domain/edge cases, then choose its proof. Reuse Mathlib objects; give useful
domain definitions constructors and bridges. Basic.lean may contain foundational theorems.
Generic algebraic APIs should not force real scalars or Fin indices without a mathematical reason.

Matrix/Functions is the deterministic matrix-function group: functional calculus, exp/log,
operator convexity, entropy, Lieb and trace-function inequalities. Matrix/OperatorTheory has
been consolidated into it. Probability/Concentration owns expectations, MGFs, independence and
tail bounds built on this theory; a matrix exponential inside a probability statement belongs
there. Import individual function modules or NLAlib.Matrix.Functions.
Historical migration briefs do not override current standards.

For catalogued results, update source tags and hand-authored atlas statements, then build and run
AuditTrusted.lean, Lint.lean, Audit.lean, ExtractDecls.lean, sync_atlas.py, the repository checks,
and the downstream examples. Examples/Downstream.lean demonstrates the matrix and subspace API;
Examples/Probability.lean demonstrates the probability API.
